subject: Bottom of the Well
text: A Gold Skulltula and a small chest are located in a closed off part of the main room reached using the Lens of Truth and a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Use the Lens of Truth to traverse
 the next room safely, and enter the next door. You'll be at a closed off part 
 of the main room with a Like Like, small chest, and this Gold Skulltula.

subject: Bottom of the Well
text: In Master Quest, a Gold Skulltula is found behind a statue on the opposite side of a locked room on B1.

evidence.quote:
Enter the
 locked door. Ignore the Gibdo (Sun's Song) and go to the other side of the
 room to find a Gold Skulltula behind a statue.

subject: Ganon's Castle Grounds
text: Gold Skulltula #064 is hanging around the ruined gate in Ganon's Castle Grounds.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #064: [ ] ... How to get: The area is actually Hyrule Castle Grounds in the future. Caught you off guard, eh? Anyway, this Gold Skulltula is hanging around the ruined gate.

subject: Death Mountain Crater
text: Dropping a Bottle of Bugs onto the plot of dirt in Death Mountain Crater as Young Link releases Gold Skulltula #065.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #065: [ ] ... How to get: Head to Death Mountain Crater as Young Link using the Bolero of Fire, and drop a Bottle of Bugs onto the plot of dirt to release this spider.

subject: Fire Temple
text: Moving the blue block on the first floor with the Song of Time allows Link to reach a room with flying floor tiles, a Like Like, and Gold Skulltula #066.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #066: [ ] ... How to get: In the large room of the first floor, head to where the blue block is, and use the Song of Time to move it. Use it as a stepstone to reach the door above. The room past the door has flying floor tiles, a Like Like, and a Gold Skulltula.

subject: Fire Temple
text: In Master Quest, pounding the switch in the large lava room with the Megaton Hammer frees a trapped Goron and reveals Gold Skulltula #066.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #066 (Master Quest): [ ] ... How to get: In the large lava room with a bunch of platforms, take the lower door on the north side to find a Goron trapped in a cell. Pound the switch with the hammer, then free the Goron. Kill the Gold Skulltula held there.

subject: Fire Temple
text: Bombing the wall that produces a different sound when swiped with a sword in the third-floor boulder maze reveals a room with Gold Skulltula #067.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #067: [ ] ... How to get: Up at the maze room with boulders on the third floor, search around the perimeter of the maze until you hear a Gold Skulltula scratching around. Swipe your sword against the wall where you hear the Skulltula. If it makes a different sound than usual, bomb that place to reveal a small room with the Gold Skulltula.

subject: Fire Temple
text: In Master Quest, extinguishing the fire and pulling away the block allows Link to Hookshot Gold Skulltula #067 and its token.

evidence.quote:
Gold Skulltula #067 (Master Quest): [ ] ... Step on it to bring the fire down, then
 Hookshot back up. Quickly pull away the block enough so that it will be out of
 the fire, then Hookshot the Skulltula and its token.

subject: Fire Temple
text: Playing the Scarecrow's Song above the boulder maze enables Link to Hookshot up to a rising platform and reach a room with Gold Skulltula #068 on a grating.

evidence.quote:
Gold Skulltula #068: [ ] ... Face right, play the Scarecrow's
 Song, and Hookshot up using the scarecrow. Hookshot to the platform, and it'll
 rise to a room. Head through the door, climb the first grating, and you'll
 see this Skulltula on the next.

subject: Fire Temple
text: In Master Quest, bombing the wall in the bottom alcove of the fire maze's middle chamber reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
In the room with fire mazes, enter the middle chamber from the 
 bottom (left door from the entrance is a good one), then find the alcove down
 there. Bomb the wall to reveal a Gold Skulltula.

subject: Fire Temple
text: Gold Skulltula #069 is found crawling on the wall over a huge hole in the floor and can be retrieved using the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #069: [ ] ... How to get: In the room right after the room with the previous Gold Skulltula, you'll see this one crawling around on the wall over the huge hole in the floor. Use the Hookshot to grab it.

subject: Fire Temple
text: In Master Quest, playing the Song of Time moves a blue block to bypass a fire blockade and reach a room where defeating a Lizalfos allows collecting a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
In the room with fire mazes, go right from the entrance door to
 find a blue block blocked off by fire. Play the Song of Time near it to move
 it. Climb up to it and jump over the fire blockade. Enter the nearby door here
 and kill the Lizalfos before getting the Gold Skulltula.

subject: Fire Temple
text: Pounding away the pillar in the entrance room with the Megaton Hammer and using a Small Key leads to a room with flying floor tiles, a Like Like, and Gold Skulltula #070.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #070: [ ] ... How to get: Once you get the hammer, head down to the entrance room of the temple. Pound away the pillar, then head through the door. (Must have a Small Key.) Eliminate all the enemies in the next room to proceed, and in this next room, you'll encounter some flying floor tiles, a Like Like, and this Skulltula.

subject: Fire Temple
text: In Fire Temple Master Quest, summoning Pierre with the Scarecrow's Song allows Link to Hookshot up and open a formerly flaming chest for a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Play
 your Scarecrow's Song to make Pierre appear. Step on the switch below and
 Hookshot up using him, and open the once-flaming chest for a Small Key.

subject: Fire Temple
text: In Fire Temple Master Quest, defeating two Stalfos, hammering the small pillar, and Hookshotting the wall face opens the door to Gold Skulltula #070.

evidence.quote:
Gold Skulltula #070 (Master Quest): [ ] ... Kill the two Stalfos, and hammer the small pillar to make stairs
 appear. Go partway down them and Hookshot the face on the wall to open the
 door. Go through that and the Gold Skulltula awaits.

subject: Death Mountain Trail
text: Smashing the red boulder where the Bomb Flower previously grew on Death Mountain Trail with the Megaton Hammer reveals Gold Skulltula #071.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #071: [ ] ... How to get: Remember where the Bomb Flower used to be in the past? The one you used to open Dodongo's Cavern? There's a red boulder there now. Smash it with the Megaton Hammer to reveal this Skulltula.

subject: Death Mountain Trail
text: Smashing the red boulder against the wall in the area where fiery rocks fell on Death Mountain Trail reveals Gold Skulltula #072.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #072: [ ] ... How to get: At the area where fiery rocks fell on you in the past, there's a lot of red boulders here. The one that's against the wall hides this Skulltula.

subject: Ice Cavern
text: Gold Skulltula #073 is situated on the wall in the second room with giant ice blades in the Ice Cavern.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #073: [ ] ... How to get: In the second room with the giant ice blades, there's a Skulltula on the wall here.
